## UseWheelZoomOptions.toDataPoint property

Converts a pixel position (relative to the element the handler is attached to) to a data-space point.

**Signature:**

```typescript
toDataPoint: (pixelX: number, pixelY: number) => {
        x: number;
        y: number;
    };
```
